output.summary: The Board approves an out-of-state trip for sixteen students in grades 10-12 and five adults from Oakland High School to a boys basketball tournament in Portland, Oregon. The trip dates, December 6 through December 9, 2023, fall before the Board's December 14, 2023 meeting. It costs the district nothing.

output.headline: Ratifies three appointments to the Measure BJY school facilities bond oversight committee
output.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointment of three members to the Measure BJY Independent Citizens' School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee. Each fills an unexpired term starting December 14, 2023: two end June 30, 2025 and one ends June 30, 2024. The seats are membership categories required by state law and Board policy for voter-approved bond measures.
